_about: WP-09: the owner-blessed intended differences of the authorisation matrix (backend/test/authz-matrix.test.js). Every entry carries its reason. Taken from the audit's recommendation under the execution directive of 2026-11-27; an entry is changed only with a reviewed diff.

viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/open: Records the caller's own active project and the opened time; changes no project content.
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/copy: Creates a NEW project owned by the caller from content the caller can already read; the source is not changed.
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/convert: Creates a NEW project owned by the caller in another format; the source is only read.
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/publish/configure: Computes which modules a configured build would include; read-only (POST because the selection is a body).
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/packages/delivery: Builds a delivery ZIP for download from content the caller can read; the only record written is the administrator's dispatch log entry.
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/jss/validate: Validates the posted or saved JSS document; writes nothing.
viewerWrites.POST /api/projects/:id/jsg/validate: Validates the posted or saved JSG document; writes nothing.

authOnlyWrites.POST /api/gitlab/connect/oauth: Phase 3 (P3-5): starts the caller's own GitLab connection (state bound to the caller); 404 FEATURE_OFF until an administrator configured GitLab.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/gitlab/connect/token: Phase 3 (P3-5): connects the caller's own GitLab account with the caller's own personal access token; 404 FEATURE_OFF until configured.
authOnlyWrites.DELETE /api/gitlab/me: Phase 3 (P3-5): disconnects the caller's own GitLab account (and revokes its OAuth token).
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/auth/activity: Refreshes the caller's own session (idle limit).
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/auth/change-password: Changes the caller's own password; the current password is required.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/auth/onboarding: Completes the caller's own first sign-in.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/invitations/:id/accept: The handler only accepts an invitation addressed to the caller (404 otherwise).
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/invitations/:id/decline: The handler only declines an invitation addressed to the caller (404 otherwise).
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/folders: Folders are per person; the service decides with the caller's identity.
authOnlyWrites.PATCH /api/folders/:key: The service checks the caller's rights on the folder.
authOnlyWrites.DELETE /api/folders/:key: The service checks the caller's rights on the folder (and on its projects with withProjects=1).
authOnlyWrites.PUT /api/folders/:key/access: The service checks that the caller may grant access on the folder.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects: Any signed-in person may create a project and becomes its owner.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects/sample: Creates a sample project owned by the caller.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects/sample-jsg: Creates a sample JSG project owned by the caller.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects/sample-jss: Creates a sample JSS project (Land or Naval User Handbook) owned by the caller.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/notifications/read: Marks the caller's own notifications read.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/cir: The Common Information Repository is shared: every signed-in person may add modules (by design, see authz.js evaluate).
authOnlyWrites.DELETE /api/cir/:id: The service refuses Authors (403 CIR_DELETE_ROLE); Project Managers and administrators may delete.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/cir/:id/copy: The handler evaluates editor rights on the target project (404 otherwise).
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/s1000d/validate-config: Validates a posted configuration against the defaults; writes nothing.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects/import/detect: Inspects an uploaded file; writes nothing but a temporary upload.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/projects/import: Creates a NEW project owned by the caller from an uploaded archive.
authOnlyWrites.POST /api/xengine/import: Creates a NEW project owned by the caller from an uploaded package or document.
